title: NEON RAJA: Cyberpunk King BGM (original score)
description:
A king rules a rain-soaked neon city of the future. This is his entry: a hero-elevation theme written the South Indian film way, played on synths, guitar and brass, with a new sound taking the hook every few seconds.

For fans of mass BGM, hero entry themes, cyberpunk and synthwave. Headphones on.

Music: Neon Raja, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
